016package org.vafer.jdeb.mapping;
017
018import org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarArchiveEntry;
019import org.vafer.jdeb.utils.Utils;
020
021/**
022 * Applies a uniform set of permissions and ownership to all entries.
023 */
024public final class PermMapper implements Mapper {
025
026  private final int strip;
027  private final String prefix;
028  private int uid = -1;
029  private int gid = -1;
030  private String user;
031  private String group;
032  private int fileMode = -1;
033  private int dirMode = -1;
034
035  public static int toMode(String modeString) {
036    if (modeString != null && modeString.length() > 0) {
037      try {
038        return Integer.parseInt(modeString, 8);
039      } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
040        System.err.println("Invalid mode string: " + modeString);
041        return -1;
042      }
043    }
044    return -1;
045  }
046
047  public PermMapper(
048    int uid,
049    int gid,
050    String user,
051    String group,
052    int fileMode,
053    int dirMode,
054    int strip,
055    String prefix
056  ) {
057    this.strip = strip;
058    this.prefix = prefix == null ? "" : prefix;
059    this.uid = uid;
060    this.gid = gid;
061    this.user = user;
062    this.group = group;
063    this.fileMode = fileMode;
064    this.dirMode = dirMode;
065  }
066
067  public PermMapper(
068    int uid,
069    int gid,
070    String user,
071    String group,
072    String fileMode,
073    String dirMode,
074    int strip,
075    String prefix
076  ) {
077    this(
078      uid,
079      gid,
080      user,
081      group,
082      toMode(fileMode),
083      toMode(dirMode),
084      strip,
085      prefix
086    );
087  }
088
089  public TarArchiveEntry map(final TarArchiveEntry entry) {
090    entry.setName(
091      Utils.stripLeadingSlash(
092        Utils.joinUnixPath(prefix, Utils.stripPath(strip, entry.getName()))
093      )
094    );
095
096    // Set ownership
097    if (uid > -1) {
098      entry.setUserId(uid);
099    }
100    if (gid > -1) {
101      entry.setGroupId(gid);
102    }
103    if (user != null) {
104      entry.setUserName(user);
105    }
106    if (group != null) {
107      entry.setGroupName(group);
108    }
109
110    // Set permissions
111    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
112      if (dirMode > -1) {
113        entry.setMode(dirMode);
114      }
115    } else {
116      if (fileMode > -1) {
117        entry.setMode(fileMode);
118      }
119    }
120
121    return entry;
122  }
123}
